from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs/task-1c474647.py')
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != 0 and (ny, nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells); r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells); c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            rings = {}
            for y, x in cells:
                d = min(y-r0, r1-y, x-c0, c1-x)
                rings.setdefault(d, set()).add(grid[y][x])
            palette = [next(iter(rings[d])) for d in sorted(rings)]
            mapping = {color: palette[-1-i] for i, color in enumerate(palette)}
            for y, x in cells:
                out[y][x] = mapping[grid[y][x]]
    return out
'''
